summary: Retest of ScrollToHash fix (behavior:'auto' + 800ms settling re-scroll) for Navbar Gallery/Reach out links navigating from /supper-club/barsaat back to landing. Ran 6 core scenarios plus a stability sweep. PASS: Desktop Contact from /barsaat (top=0.27, scrollY=8982); Mobile Gallery from /barsaat (top=0, scrollY=7164); Mobile Contact from /barsaat (top=0.05, scrollY=10770); Same-page Gallery on / (top=-0.36); Same-page Contact on / (top=0.27). PARTIAL/FLAKY: Desktop Gallery from /barsaat — 4-run stability sweep at 1440x900 shows only 2/4 (50%) attempts land within viewport. Failures include one run where scrollY=0 with #gallery.top=5882 (scroll never happened at all) and one where top=1474 (scrolled ~574px short). Contact does not exhibit this because it's the last section — Gallery sits mid-document so lazy sibling content loading after the 800ms settle re-scroll can push it out of view. Fix improved reliability significantly vs iter-17 (which was 0/2) but is not yet 100% reliable on desktop for the Gallery target.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent scroll landing (~50% success at viewport 1440x900). Observed outcomes across 4 back-to-back attempts (5s post-click wait each): top=1474/scrollY=4408 (short scroll), top=5882/scrollY=0 (no scroll at all), top=0.6/scrollY=5882 (OK), top=110/scrollY=5772 (OK). Same test at 390x844 mobile passes reliably; Contact target passes reliably at both breakpoints because it's the last section. Suspected cause: after the 800ms settling re-scroll runs, additional lazy-loaded content above #gallery (Story/About/Events sections) continues to expand the document (docH grows 9708 -> 10251 within first ~1s), shifting #gallery downward. When the settle-scroll fires before the layout stabilizes, gallery lands short. The scrollY=0 failure suggests the pathname vs hash may update in separate effect runs (pathname '/' arrives first with hash='' -> useEffect else-branch runs window.scrollTo(0) -> hash arrives later triggering tryScroll, but if lazy content triggers layout invalidation between the initial scrollIntoView and settle, the browser may reset).

action_items: Harden ScrollToHash further for mid-document targets on desktop. Options: (a) increase the settling-re-scroll delay from 800ms to ~1500ms or add a second re-scroll at 1600ms; (b) use a ResizeObserver on document.body to trigger a re-scroll every time docH changes within the first ~3s after hash change (until scrollY stabilizes at the target); (c) wait for all and
critical_code_review_comments: App.js ScrollToHash: the useEffect else-branch unconditionally scrolls to top on any pathname change with empty hash. On a Link click from /supper-club/barsaat to {pathname:'/', hash:'#gallery'}, React Router can commit pathname before hash in some cases, causing a spurious scrollTo(0) that fights the subsequent hash effect. Guard with a small delay or a ref check to avoid this race.

The retry loop runs up to 30x100ms = 3s but the 800ms settle-scroll is a single shot. For mid-document lazy content this is not enough; consider an observer-based approach that re-scrolls until scrollY is within a tolerance of the target and stays stable for one animation frame.

Gallery.jsx and other landing sections likely lazy-load (images/videos). Consider adding intrinsic aspect-ratio containers so that space is reserved for media BEFORE content loads — this removes late layout shifts and eliminates the need for aggressive settling re-scrolls.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 core scenarios pass (83%); Desktop Gallery cross-page is flaky at 2/4 (50%). Contact and Mobile flows are 100% reliable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-17's recommended fix (behavior:'auto' + 800ms settling re-scroll) IS now applied in /app/frontend/src/App.js lines 24-49 and works for 5/6 scenarios. Only remaining issue is Desktop Gallery cross-page flakiness (~50% at 1440x900) due to mid-document lazy content growth after the single 800ms settle. Mobile 390x844 works reliably for the same target because content stacks vertically and lazy shifts don't push targets as much relative to the smaller viewport. Recommended next fix: extend to a resize-observer-driven re-scroll loop OR add a second settle at 1600ms, then retest with 4-attempt stability sweep. rca of the issue: The ScrollToHash retry (30 attempts x 100ms) plus a single settle-rescroll at 800ms handles targets that stabilize within 800ms after route change. Empirically, on the landing page docH grows from ~9708px to ~10251px in the first ~1000ms as sections above #gallery lazy-render images/videos. If the settle-rescroll executes at 800ms while docH is still growing, #gallery ends up 200-1500px above or below the fold. #contact (last section) is not affected because further growth below it (there is none) can't move it away from the top; and mobile is less affected because the target's viewport-relative position is more forgiving. Reproduce: 1440x900 viewport, /supper-club/barsaat, click [data-testid=nav-gallery], wait 5s, read #gallery.getBoundingClientRect().top. Expect within [-100, 500]; actual is intermittent, ~50% out of range. Mitigation: swap the fixed 800ms settle for a ResizeObserver-based loop that re-scrolls to hash until (a) target.top is within tolerance AND (b) docH is stable for 250ms, with a max timeout of ~3s.
